implementation.behavior: Default command execution now uses the pinned SDK shared native process supervisor; the previous Bun.spawn path is removed. implementation.captureBudget: 1..64 MiB per stream through producer capture-lossless; overflow is explicit and never silently truncates a pipeline result
implementation.compatibility: Existing workflows had no deadline; absent caller timeout retains that behavior. Invalid explicit deadlines reject before spawning.
implementation.portability: The Bun execution surface loads the SDK lazily. Root/server entries bundle for Node without bun:ffi, bun:sqlite, sharp or A2A code.
